REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, February 20, 2018 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717

8.
APPROVAL OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH FAIRBANK, MASLIN, MAULLIN, METZ AND ASSOCIATES (FM3) TO CONDUCT A COMMUNITY SURVEY
Presented by City Manager Smoot
ACTION: That the City Manager be authorized to execute a Professional Services Agreement with Fairbank, Maslin, Maullin, Metz & Associates (FM3) in an amount not to exceed $28,500.
Item #8
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-k, be approved.

ORD NO. 795 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, adding Chapter 7.5 (Unclaimed Property) to Title II (Administration) of the Lomita Municipal Code to dispose of unclaimed property within the jurisdiction of the City of Lomita. (Second Reading)
ACTION: That said ordinance be adopted.
Item #7j
k.
Purchase of a 2018 Ford Transit Connect from AutoNation Ford of Torrance for the Public Works Department
ACTION: That the City Manager be authorized to purchase a 2018 Ford Transit Connect from AutoNation Ford of Torrance for the Public Works Department in the amount of $25,571..
Item #7k
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
9.
DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE FUNDING ALLOCATION FOR THE 2017 LOCAL GOVERNMENT PARTNERSHIP PROGRAM OFFERED BY THE MOBILE SOURCE AIR POLLUTION REDUCTION REVIEW COMMITTEE
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
ACTION: That the City Council by minute order approve the following:
1)
Acknowledge the receipt of the Mobile Source Air Pollution Reduction Review Committee's (MSRC) Program presentation by MSRC Program staff;
2)
Authorize staff to apply for MSRC funds for the following projects: the installation of bicycle racks throughout the City, the lease of a new all electric vehicle for parking enforcement, and the installation of bicycle lanes and associated signage and striping on Walnut Street between 253rd and 257th Streets; and
3)
Allocate $32,750 in matching funds from various accounts as outlined within the staff report.
Item #9
10.
CONSIDERATION OF AN AGREEMENT OF A COUNCIL REPRESENTATIVE AND ALTERNATE TO THE SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA CONSORTIUM (SCC) JPA BOARD
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
ACTION: Staff recommends the City Council appoint a representative and alternate (with authority to vote for dissolution of the JPA) to the SCC Board for the purpose of dissolving the inactive SCC JPA.
Item #10
11.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to a Special Meeting to be held on Tuesday, February 27, 2018, at 4:30 p.m. in the Don Knabe Community Room at 24200 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
